projects.name: upliftpolicy
projects.description: Retention targeting by uplift rather than churn propensity, with doubly-robust policy evaluation that finds the customers your outreach drives away.
highlights: Contacting the top 30% by uplift adds 4.47 points of retention; the same budget ranked by churn score loses 0.23 points.
Sleeping dogs make up 37% of the churn-ranked list and 4% of the uplift-ranked list.

projects.name: attributiongap
projects.description: Markov removal-effect attribution scored against holdout-experiment truth, publishing a per-channel bias factor that corrects the daily numbers between experiments.
highlights: On 60,000 simulated users, Markov attribution over-credits display 3.89x and brand search 2.34x, and under-credits generic search.
Each factor carries the age of its experiment and is shrunk as the evidence goes stale.

projects.name: marginbridge
projects.description: A price-volume-mix margin bridge that reconciles exactly, plus price elasticity estimated with the discount confounder controlled.
highlights: Volume growth hid a mix-shift headwind (88%) and price erosion (12%).
Naive elasticity misses the truth in every segment; the corrected intervals cover it.

projects.name: retail-margin-cockpit
projects.description: A governed margin and inventory model: a tested dbt star schema, a DAX measure library and a Power BI model with row-level security.
highlights: Six marts covered by 56 dbt tests on reproducible POS, Shopify and inventory data.
Regional Manager and HQ Analyst roles, with the same boundary enforced in Postgres.

projects.name: field-ops-sql-cost-audit
projects.description: A dbt and SQL project that reconciles messy field-operations data into a true cost-to-serve per job and shows where SLA breaches concentrate.
highlights: A recursive CTE rebuilds route order; window functions give 4-week rolling utilization.
A data-quality exceptions view keeps excluded jobs visible.

projects.name: cuped
projects.description: A CUPED variance-reduction library for A/B tests that refuses covariates measured after randomisation and tests that bias case explicitly. It combines a declared-window check with a balance test across arms.
highlights: On a 30,000-customer demo, CUPED removed 38.7% of the variance, turning an 11-week test into a 7-week one.
A post-treatment covariate removed 98.3% of variance yet returned an effect of -6.601 against a true 1.80; the gate rejects it.

projects.name: mixpriors
projects.description: A Bayesian media mix model with informative adstock and saturation priors. Its budget optimiser maximises expected return under the posterior and reports a credible interval instead of a single number.
highlights: In the demo, all 9 of 9 true channel values fall inside their 90% intervals.
Scored on the true curves, the posterior-aware plan gained +2.77% while the point-estimate shortcut lost 1.18%.
Splits a GBP 45M annual budget across nine channels from 156 weekly observations.

projects.name: uattriage
projects.description: UAT analytics that fit defect-discovery curves to estimate remaining latent defects and a go-live readiness date with an uncertainty band, instead of reporting raw defect counts.
highlights: Refuses to project when discovery has not flattened (b*T < 0.7) instead of returning a runaway number.
Demo on a simulated UAT project: 807 defects over 45 days, with latent-defect intervals per severity.
Calibration tests check interval coverage over 200 runs.

projects.name: claimsflow
projects.description: Process mining on motor insurance claim event logs that checks each case against the designed process and costs every known rework loop in days and money.
highlights: Only 32,593 of 50,000 claims (65%) follow the designed 11-step path.
Ranks three rework loops by cost, for a total annual rework cost of GBP 4,544,492 in the demo.
Waiting time makes up 60% of elapsed time.

projects.name: realtime-stock-market-pipeline
projects.description: A real-time stock market analytics pipeline on a Lambda architecture. Kafka and Spark Structured Streaming feed Z-score anomaly detection, a daily batch reconciliation, dbt models and a Grafana dashboard.
highlights: Rolling 1-minute, 5-minute and 1-hour OHLCV aggregations.
Z-score anomaly alerts graded WARNING, CRITICAL and EXTREME.
12 unit tests pass across 3 suites.

projects.name: costlens
projects.description: Offline Kubernetes cost allocation and VPA-style rightsizing from Prometheus exports. It keeps money as exact integer nano-dollars and backtests its recommendations on held-out weeks.
highlights: Allocated + idle + shared == total holds exactly, not approximately.
Backtests rightsizing policies by fitting on train weeks and reporting on held-out test weeks.
Runs on a simulated six-week, seven-node, multi-team cluster.

projects.name: kube-rightsizer
projects.description: Right-sizes Kubernetes workloads from real Prometheus usage history and opens a reviewable GitHub pull request against a GitOps repo, never mutating live objects.
highlights: Recommends per-container CPU and memory using p95 usage plus 15% headroom by default.
A change threshold keeps stable workloads from generating pull request noise.

projects.name: netreach
projects.description: A Go network reachability analyser for AWS-style VPC snapshots. It uses interval arithmetic over CIDR and port ranges to explain exactly why traffic is allowed or blocked.
highlights: Computes exact answers over a space of about 3.7 × 10^19 flows without sampling.
Checks six hand-built fixtures against hand-derived ground truth.

projects.name: ratewall
projects.description: A pluggable token-bucket rate limiter for Python: a pure-Python core plus drop-in Starlette/ASGI middleware that answers 429 Too Many Requests with an honest Retry-After.
highlights: Storage sits behind a Protocol and the clock is injected, so tests drive time by hand.
29 deterministic tests, none of which sleep.
